Section 1.  Tenant’s Insurance.  Tenant shall maintain, at its sole cost and expense, throughout the Term: (a) commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $3,000,000 in the aggregate, naming Landlord as an additional insured; (b) professional/medical malpractice liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $3,000,000 in the aggregate; and (c) property insurance covering Tenant’s personal property, medical equipment, and improvements at replacement cost. Tenant shall deliver a certificate of insurance evidencing such coverage to Landlord prior to the Commencement Date.

Tenant shall also maintain (d) umbrella or excess liability coverage of not less than $5,000,000; (e) workers’ compensation at statutory limits and employer’s liability coverage; (f) business-interruption and extra-expense coverage for at least twelve (12) months; and (g) if Tenant handles regulated medical waste, hazardous drugs, or radiologic materials, pollution or environmental liability coverage. Tenant’s property coverage shall expressly include the clinical build-out. Professional and medical-malpractice coverage shall be occurrence-based where available or, if claims-made, include tail coverage on termination. Landlord, its property manager, and its lender shall be additional insureds on the commercial general liability, umbrella/excess, and applicable pollution policies, on a primary and non-contributory basis, with a waiver of subrogation in Landlord’s favor, thirty (30) days’ notice of cancellation, insurers rated A-VIII or better, and annual certificate delivery.

Early occupancy of the Premises shall not advance the termination date of this Lease.
